description: XYSKY UDP configuration. All sections are optional and defaulted. Unknown keys and null values are errors; numbers and booleans must be native YAML values. CLI overrides are merged before validation.

level.description: Pino minimum log level. Packet diagnostics require debug or trace.

pretty.description: Human-readable logs using pino-pretty; false emits structured JSON.

room.description: Immutable room configuration. Room identity is created and managed by the runtime, not stored in config.

host.description: ENet UDP bind hostname or IP address; independent of the advertised public endpoint.

public_uri.description: Public UDP endpoint advertised to clients/QWD. Use host:port or udp://host:port; IPv6 must be bracketed. No credentials, path, query or fragment. Port: 1-65535.

max_peers.description: ENet connection slots, 1-4095 (ENet peer-ID limit). Joined players remain capped at 8.

tick_rate.description: Synchronization ticks per second, 1-1000. Upper bound prevents sub-millisecond timers.

max_packet_bytes.description: Maximum accepted client packet bytes, 1-33554432 (32 MiB ENet packet ceiling).

bad_packet_limit.description: Malformed-packet count before closing a session, 1-1000000.

move_timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds before reverting a stuck MOVING session to ACTIVE, 1-2147483647 (Node timer limit).

player_state_decode.description: PlayerState decode depth: full reads the complete record; basic reads stateKind, position and velocity. First frame is always full for layout detection.

url.description: QWD WebSocket URL (ws:// or wss://), without credentials or fragment. Empty string disables QWD and runs standalone. Paths and queries are allowed.

metrics.description: Optional Prometheus metrics service, owned and stopped by the application lifecycle.

enabled.description: Enable the separate Prometheus HTTP listener. Disabled by default: no metrics listener is opened.

host.description: Metrics HTTP bind hostname or IP address. Loopback is the safe default; use a trusted network for remote scraping.

port.description: Metrics HTTP TCP port, 1-65535; separate from the ENet UDP listener.
